cand.title: Zeek Workshop Europe 2027
cand.excerpt: Strong evidence of a dated organized programme and a plausible airport-corridor lodging/meeting/catering mechanism, discounted where venue/hotel is committed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Michelle Pathe: Zeek Community Liaison / Community Lead Seat, the strongest event-programme routing contact; she announced the 2027 CERN return and authored the 2026 recap. Liviu Valsan: CERN Computer Security Team member identified by CERN, specifically thanked with the CERN team for hosting the 2026 workshop; a relevant local-host introduction, not a verified 2027 accommodation buyer. Neither person is proven to control hotel contracts. Published routing addresses: events@zeek.org and zeek-workshop-europe-2027@cern.ch.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming: 17–18 March 2027, 09:00 on day one to 17:00 on day two, Europe/Zurich. The edition-specific CERN listing and Zeek programme agree. This is within the requested horizon. No officially announced 2028 European edition was located; do not project annual dates.
findings.hotelProductFit: Conditional, secondary lodging fit rather than a core meeting-venue win. Historical 2026 attendance was “close to 100”; 2027 total attendance is unpublished and the 35-seat hands-on-training limit is not the event headcount. Against the supplied 237-room / 20–120-room commercial band, this supports testing a modest room allocation, not forecasting a full-house group or converting attendees to rooms. YOTEL is in Founex, not at CERN; its published airport shuttle is not a CERN transfer. A priced, timed CERN transfer would need validation. Its technical meeting facilities and restaurant could support an optional ancillary gathering only if requested; CERN already hosts the workshop and Corelight sponsors the reception. Resort amenities are not an evidenced purchase driver.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue: CERN, 31/3-004 – IT Amphitheatre, Esplanade des Particules 1, 1217 Meyrin, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Territory: Meyrin / Geneva Airport-side CERN corridor, not Geneva city centre, Founex/Nyon/La Côte or Lausanne. This is an announced institutional venue, not a competing hotel; a signed venue contract was not inspected.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified European workshop examples: 9–11 April 2019 at CERN IT Amphitheatre, Meyrin; 26–27 February 2025 at Hochschule München, Room R0.055, Munich; 25–26 March 2026 at CERN IT Amphitheatre, Meyrin. The 2027 announcement explicitly says the team chose to return to CERN after enjoying the previous event. This establishes repeated European workshops and a CERN return, not an annual rotation commitment or an exhaustive edition history.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 speaker pathway is self-arranged: the call states, “Speakers are responsible for their own travel and accommodation.” No 2027 housing bureau, host-hotel agreement, published room block or open hotel RFP was found in the reviewed edition pages; arrangements for other attendees remain unconfirmed. Historical 2026 guidance says hotels can be compared “using your favourite hotel booking site” and labels its table “a list of known hotels located close to CERN.” It also points to CERN hostels in buildings 38, 39 and 41. Every hotel in that historical table: Apart hôtel Séjours et Affaires Saint Genis-Pouilly; Business Park Hotel Thoiry; Apart hotel Résidhome Prévessin-Moens; Adagio Genève Saint-Genis-Pouilly; Adagio Genève Mont Blanc; Hotel Balladins Saint-Genis-Pouilly; IBIS St Genis-Pouilly Genève; IBIS Budget Genève; Hotel NH Geneva Airport; Hotel Warwick Genève; Movenpick Hotel & Casino Geneva. These are historical suggestions, not evidence of contracted inventory, actual stays or 2027 commitments.
findings.organizationStructure: The Zeek Project is an open-source network-security community project with a leadership team of contributors and community representatives, not evidence of a scaling-company-owned commercial conference. Published 2025 leadership minutes describe an established California nonprofit public benefit corporation named the Zeek Project, with governance work then ongoing; the 2027 contracting entity is unverified. CERN is the institutional host/venue. Corelight sponsors the 2027 evening reception. No PCO, DMC, agency or housing bureau is identified on the reviewed 2027 pages.
findings.competitiveLimitations: CERN is already selected for 2027 and was chosen for its host environment. The Munich precedent used free academic facilities, with catering described as the only real cost: a material barrier to selling paid replacement meeting space. Historical accommodation guidance favours on-site hostels, nearby Pays de Gex/Meyrin hotels and Geneva hotels near tram 18. No event-specific overflow, sold-out hotel, room-night total or contracted incumbent hotel was established. Historical statements about generally high regional occupancy do not prove 2027 compression.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Michelle Pathe through events@zeek.org and copy the published CERN workshop address, requesting a local-host introduction to Liviu Valsan. Ask whether an optional attendee-paid YOTEL rate may be circulated, whether any lodging agreements already exist, and the nonlocal attendee count, stay dates and transfer requirements. Only then price a modest allocation within the hotel’s supplied 20–120-room band; do not reserve or forecast that band as demand. Keep the existing CERN venue intact and avoid pitching a duplicate reception before checking the Corelight-sponsored plan.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The 2027 workshop venue is announced, so the meeting-venue sale should not be treated as open. Speakers book their own accommodation; this permits an exploratory attendee-paid rate/link discussion, not a claim of organizer-controlled room demand. Other attendee lodging arrangements, permission to distribute an offer and appetite for Founex-to-CERN transfers are unresolved. The published call is in-person only.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Relationship-led strategy, not an announced future venue tender: propose optional accommodation/transport for the confirmed 2027 CERN edition, then ask whether a future small workshop or leadership meeting could consider hotel space. Repeated workshops support maintaining the relationship, but the explicit CERN return and free-institutional-venue precedent weaken a paid venue-replacement pitch. No 2028 dates, destination or sourcing window verified.
